title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-05-30 Deligne record with complete bilingual Paper 32 Weil II working package
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so that Deligne material can be cited and revised independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing: a combined English translation-draft supplement, individually downloadable original-language reference PDFs with human-readable paper titles, and separate paper-level supplements. Paper 32, The Weil Conjecture II, now has a complete working English translation PDF and a complete working French LaTeX edition PDF as direct files. The artifact ZIP contains individual English PDFs, TeX/source files, French working layers where available, component files, reports, render checks where present, and compact provenance packages.

Status at a glance. [##########] 90/90 original-language paper PDFs staged; [######----] English-ready or working-English PDFs found locally or promoted as separate paper-level supplements; Paper 32 is now available as a complete bilingual working package. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Workflow provenance: public scans and source witnesses are converted into TeX by automated transcription systems, checked and organized locally, then packaged here with source artifacts so readers can inspect, correct, and reuse the work. The public organization is by paper and work status, not by internal run name.
notes: Standalone Deligne record linked to the main public manuscript corpus. Latest update promotes the complete Paper 32 Weil II bilingual working package and preserves TeX, logs, manifest, render samples, and the superseded section-1.8 reader in the artifact ZIP.
